description: This file contains unit test cases for the PropertyBag class in the MQTT adapter module, verifying the parsing of property bags from MQTT topics, including presence, absence, and special character handling.

classes.name: PropertyBagTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying the behavior of PropertyBag related to MQTT topic parsing.

methods.name: verifyPropertiesInPropertyBag
methods.description: Tests extraction of property values from MQTT topic with property bag parameters.

methods.name: VerifyWhenNoPropertyBagIsSet
methods.description: Tests behavior when no property bag is present in the topic.

methods.name: verifyTopicWithSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Tests parsing of topics with special characters when no property bag exists.

methods.name: verifyTopicWithoutPropertyBag
methods.description: Tests correct trimming of the property bag part from the topic.
